## Public surface

The public surface is `src/index.ts` (mirrored 1:1 by the `exports` map above) — every named
export there, nothing more. Everything else under `src/` (primitives, internal barrels like
`src/core/index.ts`, `src/cells/index.ts`, `src/filters/index.ts`, `src/pagination/index.ts`,
`src/fullscreen/index.ts`) is a private implementation detail and may change without notice, even
though those barrels use `export *` internally for this package's own modules to import from.
Adding to `src/index.ts` is fine; removing or renaming an export is the breaking change the rule
above refers to.

`CellConfig` and `FilterConfig` are closed unions by design: `createCellRegistry`/
`createFilterRegistry` can only override the renderer behind an existing `kind`, never register a
new `kind` string. `{ kind: 'custom', render }` is the intended escape hatch for anything a built-in
kind doesn't cover — see the readme's "Registry extension" section and
`src/__tests__/cells-registry-extension.test.tsx` for the decision and its proof.

`src/primitives/*` are shadcn/Radix copies owned by this package — the source of truth now that it is
vendored, not a mirror of any app's copy.

A dependency uses `catalog:` only if every vendor target's catalog has it; the rest are literal
versions, or `pnpm install` breaks in the targets that lack the entry. `@tanstack/react-table` is a
literal `"^9.3.1"` for that reason (not every target's catalog carries it).

TanStack v9 only exposes the APIs of registered features. `src/core/table-features.ts` registers every
feature and row model the table uses, once; a new TanStack call (row selection, filtering, pinning…)
needs its feature added there, or it is missing at runtime and in the types. Sortable columns use
`sortFn_v8Auto`, not v9's `'auto'`, which samples different rows and reorders client-sorted tables;
`src/__tests__/core-sorting.test.tsx` pins the v8 orders. The screenshot baselines in
`src/__tests__/__screenshots__/` were recorded on v8 and pass unchanged on v9.
